column6: Business Impact:All::% Learners in Ideal Engagement Segment
column7:
% of active learners classified in the High Effort + High Value cell of the effort-value matrix. Learners are segmented monthly based on their LE score (effort) and CME highest concept level achieved (value). Serves as a leading indicator of learning outcomes.

Delta between learning assessment scores and summative skill assessment scores. Smaller delta = better alignment between what is taught and what is tested.

Formula: |Avg learning assessment score − Avg summative score|

Students scoring above the defined passing threshold in university-conducted graded assessments — Mid-1, Mid-2, and End Semester exams — delivered in collaboration with the university. Passing threshold aligned with university grading policy.

Tracked per exam type and per semester.

Total number of prospective learner leads generated in the period through content-driven channels (organic, referral, campaigns, partnerships). Tracks the top-of-funnel contribution of content and program visibility efforts.

Source: CRM / marketing analytics. Tracked per product and channel.

Measures how much a learner meaningfully engages with learning material, adjusted for effort intensity and persistence. Passive time (video, cheatsheets) weighted at 0.5. Active time (MCQs, coding questions, notes, AI tutor interactions) weighted at 1.0. Persistence signals — reattempting after failure (+0.25) and returning to an unfinished task (+0.25) — multiply the weighted time.

Formula: LE = [(0.5 × Passive Time) + (1.0 × Active Time)] × (1 + Persistence Factor)

Tracked weekly and monthly per product. Replaces DAU/WAU/MAU as the primary engagement metric.

% of enrolled learners who complete a course in full. Encompasses all unit types — video, practice, projects, and assessments. Serves as the primary completion signal; Learner Accessed Content Completion Rate and Practice Attempt-to-Completion Rate below act as diagnostic breakdowns when this number is low.

Formula: (Learners who completed the course / Total enrolled learners) × 100.
Implemented pedagogy initiatives with measurable learning outcome improvement. Outcome baseline must be defined and agreed before the initiative is launched.

column6: Content Effectiveness:All::Learner Accessed Content Completion Rate
column7:
Applies to video units. For each learner, % of video units they opened that they also completed. Final metric is the average across all learners. Excludes units with zero opens.

Formula: Average of [(Video units completed / Video units opened) × 100] across all learners.

Applies to practice units. For each learner, % of coding/project exercises attempted that they also completed. Surfaces environment friction (IDE, playground, cloud setup) vs. difficulty-related drop-off.

Formula: Average of [(Exercises completed / Exercises attempted) × 100] across all learners.

Average in-app satisfaction rating given by learners specifically on the coding environment, playground, or cloud IDE experience. Tracked separately from overall content satisfaction score.

Source: Existing in-app rating data.
Total learning content hours created per month across all formats (video, text, interactive). Content serving multiple products counted once.
